## Purpose
A small uppercase status chip coloured from a `StatusIdentity` (from `lib/status`), with a dot that pulses for live states.

## Responsibilities
`StatusPill({identity, label, className, size="sm"|"xs"})`:
- a monospace, bold, uppercase chip with the identity's background, border and text classes;
- a 1.5 dot that animates when `identity.pulse` is set;
- the text is `label`, else `identity.label`.
